import sqlite3, textwrap, pathlib
sql = textwrap.dedent('''
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.BillingCountry AS country,
        t.GenreId AS genre_id,
        g.Name AS genre,
        CAST(SUM(CAST(ROUND(il.UnitPrice * 100) AS INTEGER) * il.Quantity) AS INTEGER) AS revenue_cents,
        CAST(SUM(il.Quantity) AS INTEGER) AS units
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il
      ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track AS t
      ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
    JOIN Genre AS g
      ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
    WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01'
      AND i.InvoiceDate < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        i.BillingCountry,
        t.GenreId,
        g.Name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        genre_id,
        genre,
        revenue_cents,
        units,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, genre_id ASC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    genre_id,
    genre,
    revenue_cents,
    units,
    country_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE country_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country ASC, country_rank ASC;
''').strip() + '\n'

path = pathlib.Path('/work/query.sql')
path.write_text(sql, encoding='utf-8')
print('WROTE', path, 'bytes', path.stat().st_size)

con = sqlite3.connect('/inputs/Chinook.sqlite')
cur = con.cursor()
rows = cur.execute(sql).fetchall()
print('row_count', len(rows))
print('sample', rows[:5])
